ruling.closes: The open question recorded by the round-2 Travel ruling: whether B1 Travel & Adventure should gloss 预约 as "Reservation" on its rows at all. It should not.
ruling.untouched: The Travel Experiences speaking and listening_type rows keyed 预约 -> 预约 carry no English gloss and are left alone. No prompt audio exists on any patched row, and the two choice rows change only their English options.

reasons: Travel unit ruling 2026-09-17, closing what the round-2 ruling left open: 预约 is an appointment — scheduling a person or a service — and a room, table or flight is 预订. A2 already glosses 预约 as "Appointment" on eleven rows; B1 Travel glossed it as "Reservation" on four, and the SRS card underneath them carried the same error. Reglossing rather than rekeying keeps the curriculum's noun/verb contrast and needs no new audio. THE CARD IS THE ROOT: it is the SRS payload the listening-choice row renders from, so correcting the rows without it would hand every learner "Reservation" again at every review.
